source_notes.origins:main_ee.md:main-easter-egg-quest: Secure the keys is the narrative chapter name (Vorkuta), not a separate inventory item. The gameplay task is to craft and upgrade all four staffs. Do not invent keys to collect. If the player already has the four upgraded staffs, this requirement is satisfied.
source_notes.zetsubou_no_shima:trials.md:overview:0: Each player gets only three random assigned trials: one easy, one medium and one hard. The difficulty sections list alternative assignments, not objectives all to complete in one game. In SUMMARY, state this selection rule, completing the assigned three and collecting all rewards for every player before electrifying the shield; do not enumerate every possible challenge. In DETAILED, explain the possible methods conditionally, not as sixteen mandatory trials.
source_notes.origins:fire_staff.md:preparation-kaguts: This section prepares the elemental upgrade. The staff is not fully upgraded until the separate shared final upgrade stage (rings, orb, Crazy Place soul charging) is done. Do not claim this preparatory puzzle alone finishes the upgrade.
source_notes.origins:ice_staff.md:preparation-ull-s-a: This section prepares the elemental upgrade. The staff is not fully upgraded until the separate shared final upgrade stage (rings, orb, Crazy Place soul charging) is done. Do not claim this preparatory puzzle alone finishes the upgrade.
source_notes.origins:lightning_staff.md:preparation-k: This section prepares the elemental upgrade. The staff is not fully upgraded until the separate shared final upgrade stage (rings, orb, Crazy Place soul charging) is done. Do not claim this preparatory puzzle alone finishes the upgrade.
source_notes.origins:wind_staff.md:preparation-borea-: This section prepares the elemental upgrade. The staff is not fully upgraded until the separate shared final upgrade stage (rings, orb, Crazy Place soul charging) is done. Do not claim this preparatory puzzle alone finishes the upgrade.
source_notes.nacht_der_untoten:general.md:zombies-chr: There is no native power switch or Pack-a-Punch here. Do not import setup from another map.
source_notes.verruckt:samantha_dolls.md:secret-easter: The mannequin location is the upstairs Mystery Box landing. Use the attached photograph; first floor in older wording means the upstairs/second floor in US terminology.
source_notes.shangri_la:samantha_hide_and_seek.md:sid: Use the main-quest section only for the eight gong locations. This side quest does not require the eclipse, Fractalizer, dynamite, or completion of the main quest.
source_notes.shangri_la:main_ee.md:main-easter-egg-qu: The tile pairing and steps 3–6 have been restored and split into ordered sources. All four vanilla players are required; do not apply vanilla player-count restrictions to every possible mod.
source_notes.moon:hacker.md:equipment-hacker-tool:0: Hacker replaces PES; the two cannot be equipped simultaneously. Do not interpret the shared slot as a prerequisite to carry both. Account for oxygen before using Hacker.
source_notes.moon:power_pap.md:preparation-activating: PAP is available immediately on Earth if the player can afford it. Power and the later teleporter route are needed for the return trip, not to unlock that initial machine.
source_notes.shadows_of_evil:side_ee/upgrade-tripmine: The cream-cakes article supplies the shared trip-mine method and purchase location, not a requirement to finish the cream upgrade first. The donut route uses the different signs/cards and sound cue described here.
source_notes.shadows_of_evil:main-ee.md:overview:0: Only the final completion/cutscene requires four players. Do not require Civil Protector, shield or Apothicon Servant as mandatory quest gates: the general guide explicitly calls those optional support equipment.
source_notes.shadows_of_evil:sword.md:base-sword:0: Access to the underground symbol wall is required. Do not invent completion of all rituals/PAP as a prerequisite for obtaining the base sword; the source describes the train symbols and Beast wall access independently.
source_notes.shadows_of_evil:side_ee/free_mega.md:req: Opening the Rift and physically taking Widows Wine from its machine are the documented prerequisites. Do not substitute the full PAP/main-quest completion for Rift access.
source_notes.der_eisendrache:main_ee.md:overview:0: Bow recipes are conditional alternatives. State the Ranked player-count rule versus Local/Unranked, and never label all four upgrades mandatory in Ranked solo. The Summoning Key reference later is an in-map story object, not a requirement to complete Shadows of Evil first.
source_notes.der_eisendrache:side_ee/plunger.md:step-: Place DG-4 as a trap in front of the exposed gears at the top of the Clock Tower. Breaking the Fire quest wall is enough: do not expand the complete Fire Bow upgrade.
source_notes.der_eisendrache:fire_bow.md:step-6-move-: Church, Mission Control and the Speed Cola room refer to the same fireplace under the dragon. The bedroom fireplace is in Richtofens room, across from Samanthas room. Place the quest arrow into the glowing fireplace; collect the reforged arrow from the sun in step 7.
source_notes.revelations:main_ee.md:overview:0: The setup list is recommended before starting, but the actual steps make Keeper, PAP and upgraded Servant necessary at their respective stages. Lil Arnies are required in their base form; the separate Arnies upgrade, masks and Wisp are optional. Do not expand other maps merely because the map areas have those names.
source_notes.revelations:keeper_protector.md:part-2-s: This is a collectible skull part located in the Revelations Verruckt area, not the full Zetsubou Skull of Nan Sapwe weapon quest. Never link across maps.
source_notes.revelations:side_ee/masks.md:keeper-skul: The already-unlocked Wolf mask and the seven enslaved-keeper turret kills are alternatives. Do not require obtaining Wolf mask as well as doing the turret kills.
source_notes.revelations:side_ee/masks.md:overview:0: Each mask is an independent unlock. If asked for one mask, do not present the other seven as prerequisites.
source_notes.revelations:side_ee/time_trials.md:tips:: The similarity to Gorod is a comparison, not a dependency on playing Gorod or unlocking its rewards.
source_notes.origins:ice_staff.md:preparation-ice-sta: Only a normal shovel and snowy weather are required for digging staff parts; Golden Shovel/Golden Helmet/red dig-ups are optional later systems, not prerequisites for this staff.
source_notes.origins:shovel_upgrades.md:equipment-sho: The Golden Shovel and Golden Helmet are later upgrades. Ordinary shovel acquisition is enough when this guide is used to support Ice staff; do not require thirty digs or a helmet for collecting the three parts.
source_notes.origins:main_ee.md:main-easter-egg-quest: The Wind staff section is supporting context for entering robot heads, not a requirement to craft Wind specifically for pressing the button. After pressing, explicitly instruct throwing G-Strike onto the stone tile outside the map.
source_notes.origins:g_strike.md:equipment-g-strike:0: Keep both melee stages and the dry return journey: charge in the church, collect the stone, return to its original Generator 2 table WITHOUT touching mud, replace it, perform the second melee stage, then collect G-Strike. Mud means re-cleaning in the church. Melee weapon options are alternatives, not separate mandatory recipes.
source_notes.origins:fire_staff.md:preparation-fire-s: Collect the Fire Crystal at the red elemental pedestal inside Crazy Place. Juggernog is not a crafting prerequisite.
source_notes.origins:staff_final_upgrade.md:preparati: For one staff, align ALL rings to that staff element color, shoot its orb, then soul-charge it in Crazy Place. Do not assign one different element to each ring, or require all four staffs to finish one individual upgrade.
source_notes.origins:music_ee_3.md:side-easter-egg-se: The three markings are distinct: first 1 at Generator 1, other 1 at Generator 1, then a 5 at Generator 5. Go prone on the floor markings in that order; do not repeat the same first marking.
source_notes.gorod_krovi:main_ee.md:overview:0: The base Fafnir shield becomes mandatory at the trophy pipe despite being listed as useful in this overview. Upgraded shield, upgraded Dragon Strike, Ray Gun Mark 3, helmets and wings remain optional; do not turn them into mandatory builds.
source_notes.gorod_krovi:main_ee.md:valve-step-quick-: This is a lookup table: choose ONLY the case matching the actual green valve and cylinder endpoint. Do not list all thirty combinations as sequential steps. Never assign a number to the endpoint valve; Tank Station and Tank Factory are aliases. If locations are unknown, explain how to identify them and ask for that pair before giving exact settings.
source_notes.gorod_krovi:side_ee/dubstep_monkeys.md:o: The manual flowerpot/shield-candle route and Crate Power Mystery Box route are alternatives. Do not require doing both.
source_notes.zetsubou_no_shima:masamune.md:part-2-rai: Mesmerize the purple-water poster, then the elevator wall by the yellow danger sign, then the underwater wall beside the original KT-4 plant pickup. The green-tank wall is an optional friendly Thrasher route, not a Masamune part. Preserve the hidden seed, three rounds of rainbow water and collection.
source_notes.zetsubou_no_shima:masamune.md:crafting-t: This final upgrade-table action is a mandatory separate procedure, even when grouped with the flask section in a summary. Explicitly return to the upgrade table and craft Masamune. KT-4 must already exist: do not instruct crafting a second KT-4 after collecting the upgrade parts.
source_notes.zetsubou_no_shima:plants.md:overview:0: Each plant is a separate recipe/variant. Normal watery plants need a bucket, not KT-4. Only fertilized variants need KT-4; do not require Masamune just because it is another fertilizing option. Watering/fertilizing odds do not guarantee every reward such as shell or clone.
source_notes.zetsubou_no_shima:trials.md:hard-trials:: The complete pool is 16 assignments (5 easy, 6 medium, 5 hard), including killing a Thrasher before it enrages. Only each players assigned three must be completed. Fruit uses the ordinary mixed-colour recipe; do not require KT-4 or Masamune.
source_notes.zetsubou_no_shima:side_ee/free_widows_wi: Only defeat the giant spider for the free perk. KT-4 is needed to enter; the remaining Masamune plant, electric shield, trials and upgrade-table steps are not required for this reward.
Grow the four ordinary recipes: blue, green, purple and mixed-colour fruit. No need to expand every fertilized or imprint recipe. Normal bucket does not require Golden Bucket; avoid circular prerequisites.
source_notes.revelations:main_ee.md:step-4-collect-th: The free-perk article is supporting context for the wall/parkour route only. Do not require collecting the free perk, completing that side quest, or adding its reward as a main-quest gate.
source_notes.zetsubou_no_shima:gas_mask.md:overview:0: Carry a fresh mask for boss-gas protection. The mask is survival preparation, not the elevator unlock trigger. Do not claim unlimited durability, invulnerability or infinite underwater breathing.
